requirements.text: Students must be able to search the catalogue and check the availability of books and resources in real-time.
Students must be able to borrow, return, and renew items online without visiting the library.
Students must be able to book study rooms online, selecting date, time, and room size.
The system must automate the fine calculation process for overdue items.
Students must be able to view their current loans, due dates, and any fines in their accounts.
The system must support inventory management and reporting tools for librarians.
The search function must include filters for author, publication year, and material type.
The search function must show real-time availability status for items.
The search function must provide related item recommendations.
The search function must be mobile-friendly.
Students must log in using university credentials through a single sign-on system.
Students must receive automated email reminders for due dates and fines.
The fine calculation system must allow configurable fine rates for different types of items.
The system must provide visibility of outstanding fines in the student's account.
The system must track historical fines for each student.
The system must restrict students from borrowing new items if their fines exceed a certain threshold.
The inventory management dashboard must allow librarians to add, update, and retire items easily.
The system must support bulk actions for inventory management.
Librarians must have advanced search and filter options for inventory management.
The system must generate detailed usage reports for library resources.
The system must integrate with existing university systems for consistency.
The system must send automated notifications for fines.
The system must provide alerts for low stock or high demand items.
